name: read-loaded-message
finalText:
The message that appeared is **"Hello World!"**, and it is visible on the page.

- **Before clicking:** The page text showed the heading "Dynamically Loaded Page Elements", the subheading "Example 2: Element rendered after the fact", and a "Start" button. There was no result message.
- **After clicking Start and waiting 5 seconds:** The Start button was gone. The page text read "Hello World!" below the subheading. A screenshot also shows "Hello World!" on the page.

The `find` action isn't permitted in this session. I used `read_page` to get the Start button instead, and it didn't affect the result.
